name: PharmaShedTags
title: PharmaShed resource tags
description: Tags PharmaShed puts in meta.tag so that model output, synthetic placements and illustrative inputs stay distinguishable from real data on a shared FHIR server.

concept.definition: The resource is produced by the PharmaShed model, not measured.
Some input parameters behind this resource are declared illustrative placeholders, not sourced values (D33). The tag is dropped when real values replace them.
The Location is a synthetic placement on a real waterway, not a real monitoring site.
A published field measurement (source R1) kept as reference data for the consistency checks; not produced by PharmaShed.
